BiblicalUsage: Bazluth is named among the Nethinim. They are the temple servants whose children returned from exile with Zerubbabel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the servants of the house are written down with the rest, and Bazluth's children are kept in the record because they belonged to the Lord's work.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
